Other routes: POST /files, POST /documents/analyze, POST /documents, GET /documents, GET /documents/:id, POST /documents/:id/send, POST /documents/:id/remind, GET /documents/:id/signing-links, GET|POST /contacts, GET /templates, POST /templates/:id/documents. acknowledgment.heading: 6. Acknowledgment and agreement
points: Confirm that you can access and review electronic documents as described here.
Agree to use electronic records and signatures for this transaction.
Understand that this platform facilitates the transaction and is not a party to the agreement.

consent.heading: 2. Consent to use electronic records and signatures
points: You consent to transact electronically with the sender, and understand that this consent is valid until you withdraw it.
You agree to review, sign and return documents electronically.
This consent applies only to the documents the sender has provided.

legal.heading: 7. Legal effect
points: Complies with applicable electronic signature law, including the E-SIGN Act in the United States, the EU eIDAS Regulation, and India's Information Technology Act.
Is legally binding between you and the sender for the documents you sign.

platform.heading: 8. Platform role and limitation of liability
platform.intro: This platform facilitates electronic transactions. It is not responsible for the content, validity or enforceability of the documents the sender sends. Any dispute about a document or its signing is between you and the sender.

purpose.heading: 1. Purpose and scope
purpose.intro: This disclosure governs the use of electronic records and signatures for documents sent to you through this platform. By agreeing, you acknowledge that:
points: You will receive and sign documents electronically.
Your electronic signature is legally binding and equivalent to a handwritten signature.

requirements.heading: 4. Hardware and software requirements
requirements.intro: To sign documents here you need:
points: A current web browser with JavaScript enabled.
An email account to receive notifications and the signed document.

retention.heading: 5. Retention of records and paper copies
retention.intro: You are responsible for making sure you can access and keep the signed documents. You can download or print the signed document as soon as signing is complete. If you would rather have a paper copy, request it from the sender. The sender may charge a reasonable fee unless the law says otherwise.

termination.heading: 9. Termination
termination.intro: Your consent applies to the current transaction unless the sender specifies otherwise. Access may be terminated for violations of the terms of service.

withdraw.heading: 3. Right to withdraw consent
withdraw.intro: You may withdraw your consent to use electronic records and signatures by:
points: Contacting the sender directly using the contact details in their message.
Notifying the sender before you complete the signing process.

disclosure.title: Electronic record and signature disclosure
